name: August 26, 2025 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  AUGUST 26, 2025
  MALIBU CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Haldeman called the meeting to order at 9:36 am.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Barry Haldeman; Vice Chair Peter Jones (arrived at 9:46 a.m.);
  Commissioners Lotte Cherin and Dennis Smith

  ABSENT: Commissioner Pamela Conley Ulich

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Chair Haldeman moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0; Vice Chair Jones
  and Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported that the meeting agenda was properly posted
  on August 20, 2025.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Election of Chair and Vice Chair

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that five Commissioners must be
  present to hold elections, and Item 1.A. would be continued to the September 23,
  2025, Regular meeting.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Greg Cahill from Clark Construction stated he wanted to learn about the Performing
  Arts Center and inquired about submitting a bid for the construction.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting

  Commissioner Cherin stated that the Commission was reviewing the building
  design concepts and conducting community outreach, and the bid for construction
  would take some time.

  Vice Chair Jones arrived at 9:46 a.m.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education

  Commissioner Cherin stated the Changing of the Verse occurred on August
  14, 2025. She stated Poet Laureate Nathan Hassall was thanked for his work
  and Charlotte Ward was introduced as the 2025-27 Poet Laureate.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  No update. Art Exhibitions would be discussed during Item 5.B.

  3.  Business and Community Outreach

  No update.

  4.  Social Media

  In response to Chair Haldeman, Community Services Director Riesgo stated
  that staff collaborated with Commissioner Conley Ulich to post and share
  items on social media.

  5.  Parcel C Performing Arts Center

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that the Performing Arts Center
  survey was available until September 8, 2025. She stated staff would attend
  community events to conduct outreach and gain feedback.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated participant responses from the July 30, 2025, Malibu Performing Arts
  Center workshop were posted on the Malibu Community Lands website.
  She stated the Commission would receive all data related to outreach
  surveys and community meetings on the Performing Arts Center at a future
  meeting.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Cherin moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to approve
  the Consent Calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 4—0;
  Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of August 26, 2025
  Page 3 of 5

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previouslv Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1. Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the April 22, 2025 Malibu
  Arts Commission Regular meeting and the June 24, 2025 Malibu Arts
  Commission Regular meeting.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  Arts Marketing

  Recommended Action: Review and provide feedback on the marketing strategies of art
  programs and events.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  The Commission discussed marketing strategies and requested additional outreach to the
  Malibu Times for an arts column.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Malibu Citv Gallerv Art Exhibition Schedule
  Recommended Action: Review and approve the Malibu Public Art Exhibitions Ad
  Hoc Committee recommendation regarding the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Malibu City
  Gallery art exhibitions.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  City requires artists to sign an agreement, which includes a clause releasing the city
  from liability for the artwork being displayed in a public space. She stated that
  artists provide a list oftheir art pieces and their values, which are given to the City’s
  insurance provider.

  Commissioner Smith stated that artists determine the value of the artwork, and the
  City should not conduct additional appraisals.

  Chair Haldeman provided information on each proposed artist and their artwork for
  the Commission to consider as part of the 2025-26 Malibu City Gallery art
  exhibition schedule.

MOTION  Vice Chair Jones moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to approve
  the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Malibu City Gallery art exhibitions recommended by the
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of August 26, 2025
  Page 4 0f 5

  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions Ad Hoc Committee. The question was called, and
  the motion carried 4—0; Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.

  TemporarV Art Works on Loan
  Recommended Action: Review and approve, Up, Up, and Away, created by artist
  Jacquelyn Blue, and Surfculture, created by Artist Denise Peak, as part of the
  Malibu City Gallery Temporary Art Collection.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  ln response to Chairv Haldeman, Community Services Director Riesgo stated
  Commissioner Smith had selected the two pieces. She stated the information was
  also provided to Chair Haldeman.

  Commissioner Smith stated Jacquelyn Blue’s artwork reminded him of a similar
  piece that his aunt owned, and Denise Peak’s artwork was different and colorful.
MOTION  Chair Haldeman moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to approve the
  acceptance of Up, Up, andAway by Jacquelyn Blue and Surfculture by Denise Peak
  as part of the Malibu City Gallery Temporary Art Collection. The question was
  called, and the motion carried 4-0; Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.

  Poetry Stone for Nathan Hassall
  Recommended Action: Review and approve the installation of a poetry stone
  honoring Malibu Poet Laureate Nathan Hassall.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  In response to Chair Haldeman, Community Services Director Riesgo stated that
  Legacy Park had plenty of space for the poetry stone.

MOTION  Chair Haldeman moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to approve
  the poetry stone installation for Malibu Poet Laureate Nathan Hassall. The question
  was called, and the motion carried 4-0; Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry programs and
  Poet Laureate Charlotte Ward’s website.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Smith stated he was honored to speak at the Changing of the Verse
  poetry event and was astonished at the turnout. He inquired about placing
  temporary artwork on the vacant triangle lot at Pacific Coast Highway and Webb
  Way.

  Chair Haldeman requested an update on the art funds related t0 the Art in Public
  Places Policy.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Art in Public Places

ADJOURNMENT

  At l 1:07 a.m., Chair Haldeman adjourned the meeting.
